grh_f4fbecf85866dd6e0acd.title: The Skys the Limit
paragraphs: Decorated fighter pilot Jerry Burton comes home on leave and, tired of being treated as a public hero, hides his identity while enjoying New York as an ordinary man. He falls for magazine photographer Jean, but his evasiveness and apparently aimless behavior make her believe he is wasting his life while editor Phil also hopes to marry her. Jerry cannot tell her that his leave is ending and that he is returning to combat. Phil sends Jean to photograph departing fighter pilots, and at the airfield she finally discovers who Jerry really is. They confess their love just before his transport takes off, with Jean promising to wait for him until the war is over.

This [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]] broadcast aired on April 24, 1949. It is listed as episode 16 in the archive. [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Fred Astaire, Edward H. Griffith, Sharon Douglas, Jay Novello, and Harry Bartell. Other credited names include Richard Allen Simmons as radio adaptor and Hal Gibney as announcer.
The surviving recording runs about 30 minutes.
This version presents a radio version of [[work|work.sdp.film.c334d82402b68976|The Skys the Limit]]. Richard Allen Simmons adapted it for radio.

paragraphs: Broke inventor Tom Jeffers and his wife Gerry love each other, but Gerry decides their marriage is holding Tom back and heads for Palm Beach to get a divorce and find a rich backer for his inventions. paragraphs: Rocky is mistaken for prizefighter Luis Gandolfo and forced into a bout that gamblers expect Gandolfo to throw.
